sourceRefs.locator: p. 3, Abstract, and p. 14, Summary: NGRIP boundary age 11,700 calendar years b2k with maximum counting error 99 years

summary.de: Eine formale geologische Grenze anhand eines grönländischen Eisbohrkerns. Das gerundete Alter 11.700 Jahre vor 2000 entspricht 11.650 Jahren vor 1950.
summary.en: A formal geological boundary defined using a Greenland ice core. The rounded age of 11,700 years before 2000 corresponds to 11,650 years before 1950.
